_doc: VALLEY REGION (chapters 1-2) — refinement of world.json's 'valley' envelope.
Same world coordinate frame as the parent. Everything here must sit inside the
envelope; refined features must stay within world.json tolerances of the
parent's coarse geometry (validated). This file is the build input for the
region tile (F2 pipeline): heights, zones, roads, planting and the vista ring
all derive from it. Town interiors of the two landmark clusters are the
existing town map files, placed by townAnchors (town local frame -> world).

elevation._doc: Coarse elevation story; the builder's analytic field interpolates. plateau = Emberbrook highland; floor descends NW->SE; gorge cuts below floor at the spine's Dellhollow stretch.

river._doc: Refined course: parent spine + meander detail. Widths interpolate parent's profile.

road._doc: The one road: Emberbrook -> Valley Gate. Forest corridor off the plateau, breaks to open meadow mid-valley, briefly riverside, climbs to the gorge rim.

portals.note: matches the town model's clifftop Valley Gate

forests.note: dense; wraps the plateau, road runs a corridor through it
far bank — Ch3 territory, uncrossable this side of Dellhollow

crossings._doc: NONE between the towns by ruling: Dellhollow's dam crest is the only span of the river.

landmarks.note: Ch1 fiction: the Whisperwood waystone at the treeline break
the tar-dark boat moored at the Moorage impression

townAnchors.note: gorge-straddling impression: buildings stepped down both rim walls, visible weirs + wheels

vista._doc: vista ring generated from world.json massifs + spine beyond the envelope

zoneOverrides.note: the gorge rims read as crag regardless of slope thresholds
